Hi I’m Manodeep - An Aspiring AI Safety Reseacher

Welcome to my site! My name is Manodeep, and I’m VERYY interested in AI safety.

Who Am I?

Let me introduce myself. I’m currently workin as researcher as TCS Research , working on alignment , safety , policy learning and interpretablility (just getting into).

My Journey So Far

Here are a few highlights:

  • Education: I have graduated from at KIIT University in Bhubaneshwar, India, pursued a B.Tech in Electronics and Computer Science with a CGPA of 9.1.

  • Experience:

    1. I’ve done 2 summer internships at IIT Bhilai, where I worded on working on a oral-cancer prediction web app. Using image classification (finetuned YOLOv8n) and symptom-based prediction using a Naive RAG system with Mistral 7B. Then i worked on Minerva an automated webapp scanner for finding vulnerability . Using a scanner, planner, and a executor agent
    2. I also work as a member of RespAI Lab, focusing on LLM Alignment. Currently, I contributed to a AAAI paper on LLM tamper resistance and presented its poster .
    3. I am working at TCS research. Co-authored an ICML paper (the realignment problem) annd wrote a paper on profiling Alignment faking on 32 human values to understand it better.

Why This Blog?

This blog will be my way of sharing my learning journey. You’ll find my portfoliio/resume (Kinda) here. and some interesting stuff i find.

Let’s Connect!

I believe that learning is a collaborative process. I’d love to hear from you! Whether you have questions, suggestions, or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out.

  • Email: manodeepray1@gmail.com
  • LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/Manodeep-ray
  • GitHub: github.com/Manodeepray

Best regards,
Manodeep
